verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Jitsu operates as an MCP *server* — 'Jitsu runs an MCP server, so AI agents can manage your pipeline directly' (jitsu-docs-19, jitsu-probe-rt-1) — which is the opposite role from what this story asks (Jitsu acting as an MCP *client* that plugs in and uses external MCP servers' tools). No evidence anywhere in the pack shows Jitsu consuming or connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
